title: TransArmor Processing Considerations
applicability: Applies to Segment 100 transactions using TransArmor encryption/tokenization (RSA, TA-VE, TDES/DUKPT, Ingenico OnGuard FPE, AES DUKPT).

businessRequirements.title: For TransArmor processing, Account Number (Element 2) shall use the TAP header format TAPnnnnnnxyyyyyyyyyyyzzzz[EDATA]: 3-byte TAP indicator, 6-byte sequence number matching Element 86, 1-byte EDATA identifier, 11-byte Key ID, 4-byte Token Type ID, and EDATA of no more than 400 bytes.

On subsequent TransArmor transactions, the unencrypted expiration date shall be sent in Card Discretionary Block Data (Element 12) as for non-TransArmor transactions, and the TransArmor token returned in the initial transaction response shall be used in the Account Number field of subsequent transactions.
A TransArmor Token Only transaction that cannot be resolved to the necessary stored token for the associated PAN shall be declined with Decline Code 4M.

A TransArmor Key and Key ID Load request shall return Response Code 'K' for an approved load or 'L' for a rejected load (merchant not TransArmor-enabled, or an invalid/outdated signing key), consistent with Load Type 'K' in Element 48.

testCases.positive: Valid TAP header and EDATA within 400 bytes; token reused correctly on subsequent transaction
negative: expiration date omitted on subsequent transaction

testCases.positive: Token Only transaction with resolvable token approved
negative: Token Only transaction with unresolvable token returns any code other than 4M

testCases.positive: Approved Key Load returns 'K'; ineligible/invalid-key merchant returns 'L'
